refs.TASK:
(In the clubroom…)

Natsuki: (already fuming) “GAH! Where is she?!”

Monika: “She’s usually the second one to arrive…”

Sayori: (entering the room) “Who are you two waiting for?”

Natsuki: “Finally! Sayori, we’ve been waiting for you. And we’re waiting for Yuri, obviously. She’s late again.”

Monika: “Yeah, it’s not like her to be this late. I hope everything is alright.”

Sayori: “Well, maybe she just got caught up with something. You know how she can get lost in her own world sometimes.”

Natsuki: “Lost? More like taken hostage by her creepy books, if you ask me.”

Monika: “Natsuki, that’s not fair. Yuri just has different interests, that’s all.”

Sayori: “Yeah, we all have our own quirks. That’s what makes our club special.”

Natsuki: (rolls her eyes) “Whatever. I just hope she shows up soon so we can get started.”

Monika: “In the meantime, why don’t we start discussing some ideas for our next club activity? Maybe Yuri will have some input when she arrives.”

Sayori: “That sounds like a good plan, Monika! Let’s brainstorm together and see what we can come up with.”

Natsuki: “Fine, but we better not spend the entire meeting waiting for Yuri. If she’s not here soon, I say we start without her.”

Monika: “Alright, let’s get to it then. I’m sure Yuri will show up soon enough.”

(As the club members begin their discussion, they can’t help but wonder what could be keeping Yuri and hope that she’ll join them soon.)

(Meanwhile, at Yuri’s place…)

Yuri: (rubbing her baby bump) “Your little sister’s going to be joining us soon, Amatsu!”

Amatsu: “I can’t wait to be a big brother!”

Yuri: (smiling) “I’m so glad to hear you say that, Amatsu. I know you’ll be an amazing big brother.”

Amatsu: “I’m gonna protect her and make sure she has lots of fun!”

Yuri: “I’m sure she’ll love having you as her big brother. You always know how to make things fun and exciting.”

(Yuri quickly checks her phone.)

Yuri: (noticing the time) “Oh no, I completely lost track of time! I need to get to the clubroom.”

Amatsu: “But what about our special sister time?”

Yuri: (apologetic) “I’m sorry, Amatsu. But the club is expecting me, and I don’t want to keep them waiting.”

Amatsu: (pouting) “Okay, I understand. But promise me we’ll have fun together later.”

Yuri: (softly) “Of course, we will. I promise. Now, let’s get going.”

(Yuri quickly gathers her things and rushes out of the house, hoping to make it to the clubroom as soon as possible. But with the added weight of Amatsu’s unborn sister, Yuri isn’t able to move as fast as she could. On her way to the clubroom, however, she starts to feel intense pain as her first contractions begin.)

(Yuri tries to compose herself and continues walking, but the pain becomes increasingly unbearable.)

Yuri: (gritting her teeth) “I…I need to…make it…to the clubroom…”

(She clutches her baby bump tighter and quickens her pace, determined to reach her friends. But as the pain intensifies, Yuri starts to worry that she might not make it in time.)

Yuri: (panicked) “Oh no…what do I do…I can’t…give birth in the hallway…”

(Suddenly, she spots a familiar face across the street - it’s Natsuki.)

Yuri: (calling out) “Natsuki! Natsuki, help!”

(Natsuki notices Yuri and rushes over.)

Natsuki: (concerned) “Yuri, what’s wrong? Why are you outside? You should be…”

(She stops mid-sentence, realizing the situation.)

Natsuki: “Oh…oh, my…are you…in labor?”

Yuri: (nodding) “Yes…the contractions started…I need to give birth…”

Natsuki: (frantically) “Oh my gosh, Yuri! We need to get you help! Come on, lean on me.”

(Supporting Yuri, Natsuki leads her to the clubroom. Once they arrive, Yuri goes into full labor.)

(In the clubroom…)

Monika: (shocked) “Oh my goodness, Yuri! Are you okay?”

Sayori: (rushing to their side) “Yuri, we need to call an ambulance!”

Natsuki: (panicking) “Hurry, Monika! Call for help!”

(Monika quickly dials emergency services while Sayori and Natsuki try to keep Yuri as comfortable as possible.)

Monika: (on the phone) “Hello, this is an emergency! We have a friend in labor at our clubroom. Please send an ambulance right away!”

Operator: “Help is on the way. Can you provide any additional information or assistance before the ambulance arrives?”

Monika: “Her name is Yuri, and she’s been having contractions. We’ll do our best to keep her calm and comfortable until help arrives.”

(Hanging up the phone, Monika joins the others in supporting Yuri.)

Sayori: (worried) “Yuri, just hold on a little longer, okay? Help is coming!”

Natsuki: (trying to reassure her) “You’re doing great, Yuri! Just breathe and stay strong!”

Yuri: (breathing heavily) “Th-thank you, everyone…”

(As time seems to slow down, the club members anxiously await the arrival of the ambulance. They try their best to comfort Yuri and keep her spirits up.)

(Meanwhile, outside the clubroom, the sound of sirens grow louder as the ambulance approaches.)

Paramedic: (entering the clubroom) “Is this the young lady in labor?”

Monika: (nodding) “Yes, over here. Thank you for coming!”

(The paramedics quickly assess the situation and prepare to transport Yuri to the hospital.)

Paramedic: “We’re going to take you to the hospital, Yuri-”

Yuri: (interrupting, through the pain) “But…my water’s about to break! I don’t know if I can get to a hospital in time!”

Paramedic: (calmly) “Don’t worry, Yuri. We’re trained professionals, and we’re equipped to handle these situations. We’ll take good care of you. Let’s get you on the stretcher and into the ambulance right away.”

(Yuri nods, clutching onto Natsuki’s hand tightly.)

Natsuki: (voice trembling) “Yuri, you’re going to be okay. Just focus on staying strong, and we’ll be right here with you every step of the way.”

(Sayori and Monika stand by, offering words of support and encouragement as the paramedics carefully transfer Yuri onto the stretcher. With the help of the paramedics and her friends, Yuri is transported to the ambulance.)

Paramedic: (reassuringly) “We’ll do everything we can to ensure a safe delivery. Stay with us, and we’ll get you and your baby to the hospital.”

(Yuri manages a weak smile before being wheeled into the ambulance. But inside the ambulance, Yuri’s water breaks - signaling the start of the pushing phase - and the paramedics are forced to bring her back into the clubroom.)
refs.X:
(Back in the ambulance, the paramedics consider the pros and cons of moving Yuri into the clubroom. They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance  as Yuri's condition changes.)

Paramedic: (urgently) "Alright, Yuri, it looks like your baby is ready to arrive sooner than we planned. Don't worry, we're equipped to handle this, and we'll do everything we can to make sure you and your baby are safe."

Yuri: (panicked) "But... I wanted to have my baby in a hospital! I’m scared..."

Paramedic: (calmly) "I understand, Yuri, but sometimes things happen unexpectedly. The most important thing is that you're in good hands. We’re here to help, and we'll do everything to make this as safe and comfortable as possible."

(The paramedics begin setting up equipment and preparing for the delivery inside the ambulance. Natsuki, Monika, and Sayori stay close, offering words of encouragement through the window as the vehicle remains stationary for the emergency procedure.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "You can do this, Yuri! Just focus on breathing and stay strong!"

Monika: (encouraging) "That’s right, Yuri! You’re strong, and your baby needs you to be brave. We’re all here cheering for you!"

Sayori: (supportive) "We’re right outside, Yuri! Everything’s going to be okay. We’re all with you!"

(Yuri, with her friends' voices echoing in her mind, begins to focus on pushing as instructed by the paramedics. The paramedics guide her through each contraction, calmly coaching her on when to push and when to rest.)

Paramedic: (encouraging) "You’re doing great, Yuri! I can see the baby’s head now. Just a little more pushing and your baby will be here."

(Yuri, gathering all her strength, gives a final, powerful push, and the ambulance fills with the cries of a newborn. The paramedics quickly check the baby's vital signs and clean her up.)

Paramedic: (smiling) "Congratulations, Yuri! You have a healthy baby girl. Would you like to hold her?"

(Yuri, exhausted but filled with joy, nods and gently takes her newborn daughter into her arms. The paramedics and her friends outside the ambulance window share relieved smiles as they see Yuri cradling her baby.)

Sayori: (tearfully) "She’s so beautiful, Yuri! Look at her tiny fingers!"

Monika: (smiling) "She has your eyes, Yuri. She’s absolutely perfect."

Natsuki: (sniffling) "I can’t believe you did it, Yuri! You’re amazing!"

(Yuri, overwhelmed by happiness, holds her daughter close and looks up at her friends, who have been a constant source of support throughout the experience.)

Yuri: (whispering) "Thank you, everyone. I couldn’t have done this without you. I’m so grateful to have you all by my side."

(The paramedics, after ensuring both Yuri and the baby are stable, prepare to drive to the hospital to complete any necessary checks and provide further care.)

Paramedic: "We’re going to take you both to the hospital now, Yuri. You did an incredible job, and we’ll make sure you’re comfortable and well taken care of."

(Yuri, with her baby girl securely in her arms, is carefully adjusted onto the stretcher once more. Her friends follow the ambulance as it drives toward the hospital, relieved and happy that everything turned out well.)

Natsuki: (tearfully) "We’ll be right behind you, Yuri. You’re never alone, okay?"

Monika: (smiling) "Exactly. We’re all family, and we’ll be there for you every step of the way."

Sayori: (nodding) "We’ll make sure you have everything you need, Yuri. You can count on us."

(Yuri, gazing lovingly at her newborn daughter, feels a sense of peace. As the ambulance heads toward the hospital, she holds her baby close, ready to embrace the future with her new family.)

refs.E1.trigger: 当任务涉及多个角色之间的特定关系定义（如夫妻关系、亲属关系、主从关系）及关联的属性分配（如谁怀孕、谁受伤、谁拥有某物）时
refs.E1.principle: 评分需强制核验角色关系网络中的属性归属是否正确。任何将属于角色A的属性（如怀孕、受伤、性格特征）错误地分配给角色B的行为，均视为根本性的逻辑错误，直接导致相关评分项失效。
refs.E1.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性’或‘角色关系准确性’维度时，建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制：首先提取任务中明确的角色-属性对（如'Irene-怀孕8个月'、'Mary-Rathalos受伤'）；其次在回答中搜索这些属性的实际承担者。若发现属性被错误地转移至其他角色（如Flame被描述为怀孕），或角色间的关系定义颠倒（如丈夫变妻子），则直接判定该候选项在关系逻辑上失败。此核验不依赖于互动的生动程度，是必须满足的基础逻辑门槛。
refs.Select.E1: 任务文本中明确设定了角色属性：Yuri怀孕（rubbing her baby bump）且即将分娩，Amatsu是她的弟弟（unborn sister），Natsuki/Monika/Sayori是朋友。评分必须强制核验这些属性是否被正确归属，例如不能将Yuri的临产状态错误地分配给其他角色，也不能混淆Amatsu与Yuri的关系，这符合经验3关于‘属性-主体绑定’校验的要求。
refs.E2.trigger: 当任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系的属性分配（如婚姻状态、生育状况）及情节发展时
refs.E2.principle: 评分需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性，同时结合叙事语境的完整性进行双重校验。任何将已确立的属性（如Sayori怀孕）错误转移给其他角色，或基于错误的语境认知（如认为故事未完结而强行改变既定结局走向）的行为，均视为根本性逻辑错误。
refs.E2.application_guide: 在构建评分标准的‘逻辑一致性与语境响应’维度时：1. 建立‘属性-主体绑定’校验机制，确保所有角色属性（谁结婚、谁怀孕）严格对应输入文本中的设定。2. 增加‘叙事阶段判定’校验：若输入文本已叙述至某事件的高潮或结尾前一刻，且无明确续写指令，检查回答是否试图通过元评论或强行续写来‘修正’或‘补充’该阶段。若回答表现出对文本完整性的误解（如建议‘描述出生过程’而原文本已暗示即将发生但未详述），则判定为失败。只有当回答在保持属性正确的同时，也尊重了文本的叙事边界（即不强行续写未指定的细节，或自然地以故事内逻辑收尾），才视为合格。
refs.Select.E2: 任务涉及虚构故事中特定角色关系（Yuri与未出生婴儿、Amatsu）及生育状况（即将分娩）的情节发展。经验6强调需强制核验角色属性归属的准确性（谁怀孕、谁生孩子），并尊重叙事边界（如原文本已推进到羊水破裂、救护车返回的关键节点）。评分标准应包含对‘属性-主体绑定’的校验，防止出现将怀孕或分娩对象错误转移给其他角色的根本性逻辑错误。
refs.N.analysis: 该任务要求基于提供的《Doki Doki Literature Club!》同人剧本片段进行创作或续写，核心情节是Yuri在去社团室的路上早产，被Natsuki发现并带回社团室，随后救护车到达但Yuri的水袋破裂（water breaks），必须被抬回社团室。评分标准需聚焦于：1. 是否严格承接‘水袋破裂’这一关键转折；2. 是否合理处理‘救护车无法及时送医’的困境；3. 是否保持角色性格一致（如Monika的冷静、Sayori的关心、Natsuki的直率与担当）；4. 是否延续剧本格式（含括号动作描写和对话）；5. 是否避免添加未经请求的超自然或荒诞元素；6. 是否体现紧急医疗情境下的真实反应；7. 是否明确说明为何必须在社团室分娩（如时间紧迫、专业设备不足等）；8. 是否以安全、关怀为导向收尾或过渡。背景信息（如Amatsu的存在、之前等待Yuri的情节）仅用于上下文理解，不作为输出义务。
refs.N1: 回答是否从'Yuri的水袋破裂，救护车被迫将其带回社团室'这一情节点直接继续？
refs.N1.X.reason: 任务要求故事从'Yuri的水袋破裂，救护车被迫将其带回社团室'这一情节点继续。然而，提供的回答开头明确写道'Back in the ambulance... They decide it's too risky and quickly prepare for an emergency delivery inside the ambulance'，这意味着故事直接跳过了被带回社团室的环节，并在救护车内完成了分娩，与指定的起始情节不符。
refs.N1.Y.reason: 任务要求回答必须从'Yuri的水袋破裂，救护车被迫将其带回社团室'这一情节点直接继续。然而，提供的回答开头描述的是'在救护车内，医护人员准备紧急分娩'，完全忽略了剧本中明确指出的'被带回顾室'这一关键转折，导致叙事起点与指定要求不符。
refs.N2: 回答是否解释了为何不能在救护车内完成分娩而必须返回社团室（如产程迅速、无专业接生条件等）？
refs.N2.X.reason: 由于回答没有遵循'必须返回社团室'的设定，它自然也没有解释为何不能在救护车内完成分娩而必须返回社团室。相反，回答中的逻辑是救护车内的情况允许进行紧急分娩（尽管有风险），这与题目要求的'因无法在车内分娩而返回'的逻辑完全相反。
refs.N2.Y.reason: 由于回答未能遵循'返回社团室'的情节设定，它自然无法解释为何不能在救护车内完成分娩而必须返回社团室（如产程迅速、无专业接生条件等）。相反，回答中的医护人员声称可以在救护车内安全接生，这与任务要求的逻辑前提相悖。
